about.title: About Vårt Marked
about.p1: Vårt Marked opened its doors on Fossumveien in Oslo in 2016 and has been a trusted neighbourhood grocery store ever since. Our experience, however, goes back more than 25 years — from earlier years in another city, under another name. With an average of more than 3000 items, we represent many different countries and cultures.
about.p2: Here you will find products from Norway, Turkey, Thailand, Iran, Russia, Greece and many other countries. It matters to us that every customer finds what they need — whatever culture they come from.
about.p3: Can't find what you are looking for? Get in touch and we will check whether we can bring the item in. We work continuously to maintain the quality of our products.
about.p4: Our goal is to get better every single day and to give our customers the best service we can offer. Thank you for shopping with us!
about.local: The store is on Fossumveien at Stovner, right next to Stovner senter, serving all of Groruddalen — Stovner, Fossum, Vestli, Rommen, Romsås and Haugenstua. A short walk from Stovner metro station, with parking right outside.

whatsapp.label: Message us on WhatsApp
whatsapp.message: Hi! I have a question about Vårt Marked.

hvor.a: Vårt Marked is at Fossumveien 60, 0988 Oslo — right next to Stovner senter, a few minutes on foot from Stovner metro station. There is parking right outside the store.

apent.a: We are open every day: Monday to Saturday 08:00–21:00 and Sunday 10:00–19:00.

halal.a: Yes. We have fresh halal meat and chicken, as well as fish and seafood.

land.q: Which countries do your products come from?
land.a: We carry over 3000 items from Norway, Turkey, Thailand, Iran, Russia, Greece, Pakistan, India and many other countries — vegetables, spices, rice, bakery and specialities.

bestille.q: Can you order an item you do not stock?
bestille.a: Yes. Contact us on WhatsApp or call 92 24 90 05 and we will check whether we can bring the item in.
